title: Sandy Feet | Royal Destinations
meta_description: Perfect Location Near Camp WaterColor- Sandy Feet by Royal Destinations
description_expanded: Description: Sandy Feet by Royal Destinations Location: WaterColor Forest District Near Camp WaterColor and The Crossings Shops Address: 165 Pine Needle Way Details Sandy Feet, a stylishly decorated 4-bedroom, 4.5-bathroom home, is located near the Camp District of WaterColor Resort. The resort is located on a coastal dune lake and offers canoeing, kayaking, and sailing excursions as well as numerous hiking and biking paths. The resort also allows access to family friendly or five-star dining experience. In addition to all that WaterColor has to offer from boutiques to dining, this house also provides easy access to Seaside where you can enjoy a variety of restaurants, shops, art galleries and entertainment. This home is uniquely decorated with original art and furniture from many southern craftsmen and artists and contains state of the art equipment such as wireless internet access, a built-in entertainment center with surround sound in the living room and speakers throughout the house, including the front porch. The home features two master bedrooms, one on the ground floor and one on the second floor both with a TV, DVD and CD player, IPOD connection, and built-in speakers. Renters will have full access to the Watercolor Beach Club, community pools, and lake. The house also features an outdoor shower and a mudroom with washer and dryer. This home has everything your family could need and is sure to provide a vacation experience your family will never forget. You will enjoy this this amazing cottage! If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: -Access To All Of WaterColor's Incredible Amenities -Unique Interior Design And Original Artwork -4 Adult Bikes -3 Parking Spaces -Beach Towel Service WaterColor Neighborhood Highlights: -Named the #1 Family Vacation Destination in the U.S. -WaterColor provides a free, on-demand trolley for guests, available daily with seasonal hours through the WaterColor Trolley app. For more information, contact our Reservations Team. -A 499-Acre Coastal Resort and Residential Community -Bike Community -Award-Winning Tennis Facilities -Beachside, Poolside and Lakeside Dining -Nearby State Parks and Preserves -4 Community Swimming Pools & Beach Club Home Configuration: Sleeps: 10 4 Bed / 4 Full Baths / 1 Half Baths First Floor: -Bedroom 1 (En Suite): King Bed/Private Bath (Shower and Soaking Tub) -Open Floor Plan, Dining, Living, Kitchen, Laundry, Half Bath Second Floor: -Bedroom 2 (En Suite): King Bed/Private Bath (Shower) -Bedroom 3 (En Suite): Two Twin Beds/Private Bath (Shower/Tub Combo) -Bedroom 4 (En Suite): Bunk Room Two Sets Twin/Twin Bunks/Private Bath (Shower/Tub Combo) Please Note: *Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. *This home is located in the WaterColor community. If you would like to rent a golf cart for your reservation, this can only be done through The Electric Cart Company. We encourage you to contact The Electric Cart Company prior to your arrival as they will only issue 60 golf cart permits throughout WaterColor at any given time. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore!
